team.abilityDesc: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism. The Pokémon also draws in all the opponent's Steel-type moves.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.desc: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Sonic Boom
moves.desc: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.desc: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.desc: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

team.abilityDesc: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon. This also enables the user to switch out of battle without fail.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.desc: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: String Shot
moves.desc: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stats.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.desc: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.desc: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

team.abilityDesc: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

moves.name: Gust
moves.desc: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.desc: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Poison Powder
moves.desc: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target.

moves.name: Moonlight
moves.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
